Title: Enter Amount
Description:
As a Gk One user 
I would like to be able to scan a QR code and enter an amount 
so that i can make a payment
Acceptance Criteria:
Given that the user scans a merchant QR Code,  
When the payment interface is presented,  
Then the user shall be directed to the app if they already have it or directed to download the app then be able to enter a payment amount and be able to change the Payee, and include an optional note with the payment.

Title: Validate Amount Entered
Description:
As a GK One user 
I want to be able to enter a minimum about for payment
so that payment is validated
Acceptance Criteria:
Given that the user is entering a payment amount,  
When the amount entered is less than $1000,  
Then the system shall prevent the payment from being submitted and display a validation message.

Title: Validate Transaction against Wallet Amount
Description:
As a GkOne User
I want to be able to send my funds to Users without exceeding my max for the wallet
So that I can always have funds
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a user initiates a transfer into their wallet
When the transfer amount would cause the wallet balance to exceed the maximum limit of 500,000
Then the system must prevent the transaction from completing before reaching the payment processor and display an appropriate error or warning message to the user

Title: Individual Payment Instrument
Description:
As a Gk One User
I want to be able to send funds to someone who doesn't have the wallet 
So that the user can receive funds
Acceptance Criteria:
Given that a user is initiating a payment,  
When the transaction is being validated,  
Then both the sender and receiver must have the GK One App installed, and the Payer must have a wallet attached, while the Payee is not required to have a wallet.

Title: Generate Receipt of Payment
Description:
As a user
I want to get a receipt after top-up
So that I can confirm my purchase
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the user has successfully completed a payment,
When the confirmation of the purchase is displayed,
Then the user should be able to view a receipt for that transaction,
And the receipt should follow the same design and layout as all other existing receipts in the system and should email the receipt, immediately, to the customer using the email address they used to register with the GKOne App​ .

Title: Review and Confirm
Description:
As a GkOne User 
I should be able review my payments details before I make a payment 
So that i can make any corrections if needed
Acceptance Criteria:
Given that the user is preparing to confirm a payment,  
When the review screen is displayed,  
Then it shall show the payment amount and provide options to select a payment method—either the GK One Wallet or a registered debit or credit card.

Title: Notification upon Payment
Description:
As a GK One user 
I want to be able to receive a notification upon an attempt to make a payment 
So that I am aware on whether it was successful or it has failed
Acceptance Criteria:
Given that a payment attempt has been made,  
When the payment is either successful or fails,  
Then the system shall send both a push notification to notify the user of the payment status.

Title: Enter a Payment Amount (Open)
Description:
As a GKOne customer, 
I want to enter the amount I wish to pay when I click on a payment link, 
So that I can make a payment to the merchant.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given when a payment link is clicked a browser link should be presented
When the payment interface is presented,  
Then the user shall be able to enter a payment amount and the Payee cannot be changed, and optionally include a note with the payment.

Title: Enter a Payment Amount (Fixed)
Description:
As a GKOne customer, 
I want to enter the amount I wish to pay when I click on a payment link, 
So that I can make a payment to the merchant.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given when a payment link is clicked a browser link should be presented
When the payment interface is presented,  
Then the user shall be able to make a payment amount and the Payee and amount cannot be changed, and optionally include a note with the payment.

Title: Display merchant verification status
Description:
As a customer, 
I want to view merchant verification information before making a payment,
So that I can confirm I am paying a legitimate merchant.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a customer is on the payment initiation screen
When the payer selects the merchant
Then a merchant information modal should be displayed.


Given the merchant has been verified through GK Pay Biz/Bill Express
When the merchant details modal is opened
Then a "Verified GK Pay Biz Merchant" badge should be displayed.


Given merchant information exists
When the modal is displayed
Then the following information should be shown:

  • Business Name
  • Business Email
  • Contact Number
  • Business Address

Title: Validate Amount (Open)
Description: gk
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the payee enters an amount below $1000
 When the payee selects Continue
 Then a validation message should be displayed
 And the payee should not proceed.
 Given the payee enters an amount above $350,000
 When the payee selects Continue
 Then a validation message should be displayed
 And payment should not proceed.

 Given the amount field is empty
 When the payee selects Continue
 Then an error message should be displayed indicating an amount is required.

Title: Guest Checkout
Description:
As a GK One customer, 
I want to provide my contact information without creating an account, 
So that I can complete a payment quickly.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a valid amount has been entered
And all required fields pass validation
When the payee selects Continue
Then the authentication/payment method screen should be displayed.

Given the guest payment form is displayed
When the customer enters:
First and Last Name
Email Address
Then the values should be accepted.

Given the guest payment form is displayed
And the merchant has created a custom field
When the form is displayed that customer field should be presented (Eg Unit Number)
Then all values should be accepted

Title: Validate Guest Checkout
Description: gk
Acceptance Criteria:
Given required fields are blank
 When the payee selects 'Continue to Payment'
 Then validation messages should be displayed.
 Given an invalid email address is entered
 When the customer selects Continue to Payment
 Then an error message should be displayed

Title: Pay Using GK One
Description:
As a GK One customer, 
I want to authenticate using my GK One app, 
So that I can complete a payment using my enrolled account.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario 1: Launch GK One payment flow

 Given the payee selects "Pay with GK One App"
 When GK One is installed
 Then the GK One application should open.

Scenario 2: GK One not installed

 Given GK One is not installed
 When the payee selects "Pay with GK One App"
 Then the payee should be redirected to the app store.

Title: Pay Using Apple Pay or Google Pay (Not MVP)
Description:
As a customer,
I want to pay using my digital wallet, 
So that I can complete payment quickly and securely.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario 1: Apple Pay availability

 Given the device supports Apple Pay
 When the payment page loads
 Then the Apple Pay button should be displayed.

Scenario 2: Google Pay availability

 Given the device supports Google Pay
 When the payment page loads
 Then the Google Pay button should be displayed.

Scenario 3: Successful wallet payment

 Given the customer authorizes wallet payment
 When authorization succeeds
 Then payment should be submitted for processing.

Title: Enter Card Details
Description:
As a customer, 
I want to securely enter my card details, 
So that I can complete payment to the merchant using my debit or credit card.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario 1: Display payment summary

 Given the payee has progressed to the card payment screen
 When the screen loads
 Then the following information should be displayed:

Merchant Name
Payment Amount
Currency
Payment Method section

And the amount displayed should match the amount entered in the previous step.

Scenario 2: Enter cardholder name

 Given the cardholder name field is displayed
 When the customer enters a valid name
 Then the value should be accepted.

And the name should allow:

Alphabetic characters
Spaces
Hyphens
Apostrophes

Scenario 3: Cardholder name is mandatory

 Given the Cardholder Name field is empty
 When the customer selects "Make Payment"
 Then an error message should be displayed
 And payment should not proceed.

Scenario 4: Enter card number

 Given the card number field is displayed
 When the customer enters a valid card number
 Then the card number should be formatted automatically.

Example
4111111111111111
Displays as 4111 1111 1111 1111

Scenario 5: Card number validation

 Given an invalid card number is entered
 When the customer attempts payment
 Then card validation should fail
 And an appropriate error message should be displayed.

Scenario 6: Enter expiry date

 Given the expiry date field is displayed
 When the customer enters a valid future expiry date in MM/YYYY format
 Then the value should be accepted.

Scenario 7: Expired card validation

 Given the customer enters an expiry date that has already passed
 When the customer selects "Make Payment"
 Then an error message should be displayed

And the payment request should not be submitted.

Scenario 8: Enter CVV

 Given the CVV field is displayed
 When the customer enters a valid CVV
 Then the value should be accepted.

And the CVV should be masked during entry.

Scenario 9: CVV validation

 Given an invalid CVV is entered
 When the customer selects "Make Payment"
 Then an error message should be displayed.

Examples

Visa/Mastercard: 3 digits
Amex: 4 digits

Scenario 10: Submit payment

 Given all card details are valid
 And required fields are completed
 When the customer selects "Make Payment"
 Then the payment request should be submitted to the payment processor.

And a loading indicator should be displayed while processing.

Title: Confirmation Receipt of Payment
Description:
As a user
I want to get a receipt after top-up
So that I can confirm my purchase
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the payer has successfully completed a payment,
When the confirmation of the purchase is displayed,
Then the payer should be able to view a receipt for that transaction,
And the receipt should show the merchant name, amount and hidden merchant email address.

Title: Notification upon Payment
Description:
As a GK One user 
I want to be able to receive a notification upon an attempt to make a payment 
So that I am aware on whether it was successful or it has failed
Acceptance Criteria:
Given that a payment attempt has been made,  
When the payment is either successful or fails,  
Then the system shall send an email notification to notify the user of the payment status.

Title: Launch Payment Plugin from Merchant Website or Mobile App
Description:
As a customer,
I want to launch the GK Pay Biz payment plugin directly from a merchant website or mobile application, 
So that I can securely complete payment without leaving the merchant experience.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario 1: Open payment plugin

 Given a customer is on a merchant website or mobile app
 When the customer selects "Pay Now", "Checkout", or a similar action
 Then the GK Pay Biz payment plugin should be displayed.

Scenario 2: Merchant context is retained

Given the payment plugin is launched
 When the checkout screen loads
 Then the merchant branding and payment details provided by the merchant system should be displayed.

Title: Review Payment Details Before Checkout
Description:
As a customer, 
I want to review all charges before making payment, 
So that I understand exactly what I am paying for.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the checkout page loads
 When payment information is retrieved
 Then the following should be displayed:

Merchant Name
Product or Service Description
Payment Amount
Fees (if applicable)
Taxes (e.g. GCT)
Total Amount Due
Payment Currency


 Given fees and taxes apply
 When the payment summary is presented
 Then the total amount should equal:Base Amount + Fees + Tax

Title: Select Payment Method
Description:
As a customer, 
I want to choose my preferred payment method, 
So that I can use the payment option most convenient for me.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given checkout has been initiated
 When payment methods are available
 Then the customer should see:
Pay with GK One App
Google Pay (where supported)
Apple Pay (where supported)
Manual Card Entry (Guest Checkout)
Given multiple payment methods are available
 When the customer selects a payment method
 Then the selected payment journey should begin.
